intro.title: Share a well. Survive the year.
intro.lede: A whole village draws from one aquifer. Every crop and every turn reveals why groundwater decisions cannot be made alone.

photo.alt: MARVI groundwater game with a shared village well and crop-watering decisions

items.title: One shared well
items.text: Every player’s choices affect everyone else drawing from the same groundwater store.

items.title: Choose the crop
items.text: Balance high-, moderate- and low-water crops across repeated watering turns.

items.title: Watch the watertable
items.text: Start after the monsoon and see whether the village can make its water last five years.
